notes:
Source: Sony's official professional product site, Specifications tab (Inputs/Outputs section), for the current-generation VENICE 2 full-frame digital cinema camera (interchangeable 8.6K sensor MPC-3628 / 6K sensor MPC-3626). The en_US URL kept looping to a country-selector page during retrieval, so the identical-content en_GB mirror (pro.sony/en_GB/...) was used and cited as sourceUrl.

Several physical connectors on VENICE 2 are proprietary Sony/LEMO/Fischer types with no exact match in the allowed connector-id list; these were mapped to the closest available id (dc-barrel) and flagged per-port above — treat those as approximate connector shapes, not literal barrel jacks.

Excluded from the ports list as non-signal/power accessory interfaces rather than external AV cabling: VF (LEMO 26-pin viewfinder interface, carries video+power+control to the EVF), Lens (12-pin) and Lens Mount Hot Shoe (4-pin x2, Cooke/i and ZEISS eXtended Data lens-metadata contacts), built-in monaural camera speaker output, and the AXS Memory (x2) / SD (x1) card slots (storage media, not cable ports).

Confirmed-from-photo device labels (matching the official product image's visible side connector panel, top-to-bottom): 12V OUT, MONITOR OUT, GENLOCK, TC IN, AUX, LAN, REMOTE. DC IN, the SDI outputs, HDMI, audio input, USB, headphone jack and the battery/24V outputs are on the opposite (unphotographed in this pass) panel, so their exact on-body silkscreen text is assumed from Sony's spec wording rather than visually confirmed.

ports.name: BATT DC IN
ports.note: Sony spec lists this as a proprietary square-shaped 5-pin battery/DC input connector; dc-barrel is the closest available id, not a literal barrel jack.

ports.name: 12V OUT
ports.note: Actual connector is a 2-pin LEMO; dc-barrel used as closest available id in the allowed connector list.

ports.name: 24V OUT 1
ports.note: Actual connector is a 3-pin Fischer connector (camera has two of these, x2); dc-barrel used as closest available id.

ports.name: 24V OUT 2
ports.note: Second of two 3-pin Fischer 24V DC outputs; dc-barrel used as closest available id.

ports.name: SDI Out 1
ports.note: Sony spec states the SDI Output bank is BNC x4 supporting 12G/6G/3G/1.5G-SDI collectively; assignment of the 12G grade to this specific labeled output is a common-convention inference, not an explicitly numbered spec line.

ports.name: SDI Out 2
ports.note: Grade-to-port-number assignment inferred (see SDI Out 1 note).

ports.name: SDI Out 3
ports.note: Grade-to-port-number assignment inferred (see SDI Out 1 note).

ports.name: SDI Out 4
ports.note: Grade-to-port-number assignment inferred (see SDI Out 1 note); 1.5G-SDI = HD-SDI.

ports.name: MONITOR OUT
ports.note: Listed by Sony as "HD MONI Output", BNC x1, supporting up to 3G/1.5G-SDI; device panel label confirmed as MONITOR OUT from official product photography.

ports.name: AUX
ports.note: Sony spec lists this BNC connector's function as Timecode Output.

ports.name: USB
ports.note: Listed as "USB host, type-A x1"; no USB version/speed stated in spec.

ports.name: Headphones
ports.note: Stereo mini jack headphone output; exact on-body silkscreen label not visually confirmed.

ports.name: REMOTE
ports.note: Sony spec lists an 8-pin Remote connector with no protocol stated; RS-422 chosen as the closest listed id based on typical Sony broadcast-camera remote-control interfaces (unconfirmed).
